items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer introduces Earle Weatherwax as a student and entertainer; the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: How did you approach that? Was that something that you found satisfying, or frustrating?
It was interesting. It’s all right. I am still in touch with one of my students. Do you think Earle would . . .?
